featured_reviews.review_text: Worst experience at this PG. featured_reviews.name: Amruta Giramkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I've had a wonderful experience staying at Shalini Niwas. The safety for girls here is top-notch, with a secure environment and measures in place that make you feel at ease. The cleanliness is impeccable, and the surroundings are always well-maintained. The management is the best I've come across — responsive, understanding, and efficient. As for comfort, the facilities are great, and the accommodations are designed to provide a cozy and pleasant stay. The owners are extremely humble and respectful towards all the tenants, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Overall, I highly recommend Shalini Niwas for anyone looking for a safe, comfortable, and well-managed place to stay.

This is a best choice for girls who seek security and good people around.

featured_reviews.name: akash kanse
featured_reviews.review_text: Shalini Nivas is a fantastic place to stay! Clean, comfortable rooms with Wi-Fi, AC, hot water, and biometric locks. The recreational area adds a great vibe, and the helpful management makes everything hassle-free. Perfect for students and professionals!

featured_reviews.name: PRANJALI MAHAJAN
featured_reviews.review_text: Shalini PG is an excellent choice for comfortable and affordable accommodation. The staff is very friendly and attentive, ensuring a hassle-free stay. The clean rooms and peaceful environment make it a perfect place to relax.

featured_reviews.name: Ashneha Makholiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shalini Nivas is an awesome place to stay! The rooms are clean, comfy, and have everything you need—Wi-Fi, AC, hot water, and even biometric locks.

The management is super helpful and makes life easy here. A home away from home 🏡💟

featured_reviews.name: Somashree Nandy
featured_reviews.review_text:
This PG is an absolute nightmare. They refused to return my deposit, showing no accountability or transparency. Adding to the chaos, they moved me from one building to another and made me wait for hours just to get the keys.

Privacy is completely disregarded here. The warden enters the rooms without knocking, and even male visitors for new tenants walk in unannounced, creating a highly uncomfortable and unsafe environment.

The management is extremely unprofessional, and the owner has a very arrogant attitude only makes things worse. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Anisha
featured_reviews.review_text: Shalini PG offers a comfortable and clean environment with well-maintained rooms and essential amenities. The friendly staff and convenient location make it an excellent choice for a hassle-free stay.

featured_reviews.name: HARSHA PRUDHVI TEJ DANDU
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience staying in this PG has been very good. The rooms are clean, well-maintained, and provide a comfortable environment for students and working professionals. The housekeeping service is regular, which helps keep the premises neat and hygienic.
The food quality is good, with a decent variety of meals served on time every day. The staff members are friendly, supportive, and always ready to assist whenever needed. Security arrangements are also satisfactory, making the stay feel safe and secure.
The PG offers essential amenities such as Wi-Fi, power backup, and clean drinking water, which make daily life convenient. The location is another advantage, with easy access to public transport, markets, restaurants, and other necessities.
Overall, I have had a pleasant and hassle-free experience staying here. I would definitely recommend this PG to anyone looking for a comfortable, safe, and well-managed place to stay.

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent cleaning service with well-maintained rooms and hygienic surroundings. featured_reviews.review_text:

Overall, it was a comfortable and reliable place to stay, and I genuinely had a great experience here.

Overall, it’s a well-managed place that provides a comfortable and stress-free stay. Highly recommended.

The location is very convenient — the railway station, markets, and medical stores are within walking distance. Security is good with CCTV and proper entry systems. The owner/manager is supportive and responds quickly to any concerns.

Overall, it is a safe and comfortable place for both students and working professionals. Highly recommended!”
